tower.quickNote: Battle Stadium sets, legal under Flat Rules.
tower.rules: Flat Rules, as Pokémon Showdown plays them: every Pokémon at level 50, bring six and pick three after seeing your opponent's team, Species, Item and Nickname Clauses, no Mythical or Restricted Legendary Pokémon. Seven wins clear a round; the seventh trainer is the Tower Tycoon.
